title: CURRENCY ( "1950.00" ) is 1950 as a currency

source.supports: the example shows 1950.00000 for this value

source.quote: will try to convert text to a number. If conversion succeeds the number will be converted to currency

derivation: The text "1950.00" converts to the number 1950, which becomes the currency 1950.0. The page's example formats the same value and shows 1950.00000.
